faq.about.availableA: hired.video is available worldwide via the web app at hired.video and through our Chrome extensions on the Chrome Web Store. The platform is primarily English today, with localization in progress.
faq.about.contactA: Email us at info@hired.video, open the live chat from the bottom-right of any page, or use the Contact form. We respond within 24 hours on business days and typically much faster.
faq.about.contactQ: How can I contact the team?
faq.about.foundedA: hired.video was founded by a team of engineers, recruiters, and designers who believed that traditional text resumes were an inefficient way to showcase human talent. We're based in North America and serve members globally.
faq.about.hiringA: Yes! We're always looking for people who care about reshaping how professionals showcase their talents. Check the Careers page for current open roles, and if nothing fits you today, feel free to reach out anyway.
faq.about.moneyA: We operate a freemium subscription model. Core career tools — building a resume, generating a video, tracking applications, joining the community — are free. Paid plans unlock unlimited AI generations, advanced analytics, team seats, and recruiter features. We don't sell user data, and we never will.
faq.about.privacyA: Your data is yours. All content you create is private by default. We're GDPR compliant, encrypt data at rest and in transit, and support full data export and deletion at any time. You can read the full details on our Privacy Policy page.
faq.about.privacyQ: How do you handle my data and privacy?
faq.about.whatA: hired.video is an AI-powered career platform that combines AI video resumes, AI resume building and scoring, job matching, interview practice, a career community feed, and sourcing tools for recruiters — all in one workspace. It replaces the patchwork of tools most people use to run their job search.
faq.features.q1.q: Is everything one product or separate add-ons?
faq.features.q1.a: One product. The Creator Studio, Learning, People Operations, and recruiting tools all live in the same workspace and share your profile, roster, and content. There's no separate license or integration to buy.
faq.features.q2.q: What can I actually make in the Creator Studio?
faq.features.q2.a: Video pitches and resumes, podcasts and audio episodes, voice clips, animated loops, pitch comics, and browser games — all from one AI-assisted canvas. Video renders client-side, so there are no per-export fees.
faq.features.q3.q: Is the built-in Learning library really included?
faq.features.q3.a: Yes. SCORM 1.2 + xAPI courses, learning paths, and HMAC-signed certificates ship with every plan. Educators and employers can spin up classrooms, assign courses with due dates, and watch progress roll up live.
faq.features.q4.q: Who are the People Operations tools for?
faq.features.q4.a: Employers and people leaders. Roster, org chart, 1:1s, goals, team-health signals, and total-cost-of-workforce reporting are gated to your team and billed per active member — no extra seat charges for materializing the roster.
faq.features.q5.q: Do recruiters get structured hiring tools?
faq.features.q5.a: Yes — scorecards with blind review and calibration, take-home assignments, live screens, an AI recruiter agent, sourcing with recruiter bidding, retained search, and warm intros are all built in.
faq.home.atsA: Yes. Every resume built in hired.video exports to an ATS-friendly PDF, with clean structure that parses cleanly in Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Taleo, and most other major ATS platforms. You can also export your resume as Word (.docx) or plain text.
faq.home.atsQ: Does hired.video work with ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems)?
faq.home.cameraA: No. You can paste any resume into our AI Studio and export a polished 60-second video with animated scenes, professional typography, and optional voiceover — no camera, microphone, or editing skills required. If you prefer to record yourself, we support that too.
faq.home.cameraQ: Do I need a camera to make a video resume?
faq.home.freeA: Yes. Creating an account, building resumes, generating one video resume, tracking applications, and using the community feed are all free forever. Paid plans unlock unlimited video resumes, advanced AI tools, analytics, and recruiter features.
faq.home.linkedinA: LinkedIn is a professional network. hired.video is a career workspace. We don't replace LinkedIn — we integrate with it via our Chrome extension. The difference: LinkedIn shows you who you know; hired.video helps you actually run your job search and build a standout video resume.
faq.home.linkedinQ: How is hired.video different from LinkedIn?
faq.home.privateA: Your resumes, applications, and videos are private to you by default. You explicitly choose what to share publicly and who can see each feed post. We're GDPR-compliant, we never sell your data, and you can export or delete everything at any time.
faq.home.startA: Click Get Started Free at the top of this page, create your account in under 30 seconds, and the onboarding will guide you through building your first resume or generating a video. Most users have a shareable video resume in under 5 minutes.
faq.home.whatA: hired.video is an all-in-one talent platform. Job seekers build AI-powered video resumes, tailor them to every job, and get matched with recruiters; recruiters and employers source, screen, and hire with video-first applications and a built-in ATS; and everyone can learn new skills, grow their network on the social feed, and earn rewards along the way. One platform for getting hired, hiring, and growing a career.
faq.home.whoA: hired.video is built for three personas: job seekers who want to stand out and stay organized, recruiters who need a modern sourcing + screening workflow, and employers who want to hire faster with video-first applications. The dashboard adapts automatically to your role.
faq.pricing.annualA: Yes — the annual plan saves 20%. Instead of ${{monthly}}/month, you pay ${{yearly}}/year (about ${{perMonth}}/month).
faq.pricing.annualQ: Is there a discount for annual billing?
faq.pricing.cancelA: Absolutely. There are no contracts or cancellation fees. Cancel from your account settings at any time and you'll keep access through the end of your billing period. Your data stays safe and you can re-subscribe whenever you want.
faq.pricing.cancelQ: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq.pricing.costA: hired.video is free to start with generous limits — AI resume scoring, one published video resume, and 50K AI tokens per month. The Pro plan is ${{monthly}}/month (or ${{yearly}}/year with a 20% annual discount) and includes 1M AI tokens/month, 1080p video export, voice cloning, brand kits, and unlimited published videos. You can cancel anytime.
faq.pricing.freeA: The free plan includes AI resume scoring, one published video resume, job-resume matching (5/month), 10 job applications/month, 50K AI tokens for tools like the resume optimizer and salary calculator, and access to the full tool suite. No credit card required.
faq.pricing.freeQ: What's included in the free plan?
faq.pricing.teamA: Yes — Pro supports multi-seat teams with per-seat pricing. Recruiters get access to AI candidate sourcing, match scoring, and a visual hiring pipeline. Contact us for volume discounts on 10+ seats.
faq.pricing.teamQ: Do you offer team or recruiter pricing?
faq.pricing.tokensA: AI tokens are the currency that powers all AI features — resume scoring, video script generation, job matching, and more. Free users get 50K tokens/month; Pro users get 1M tokens/month. If you need more, top-up token packs start at $3.99 for 500K tokens.
faq.pricing.tokensQ: What are AI tokens and how do they work?
faq.pricing.tryProA: Yes — all AI tools are available on the free tier with a monthly token budget. You can score resumes, generate video resumes, and use every tool to see the quality before upgrading. Pro unlocks higher limits, 1080p export, voice cloning, and brand kits.
faq.pricing.tryProQ: Can I try Pro features before committing?
faq.recruiters.boardsA: LinkedIn, Indeed, AngelList, Wellfound, Otta, BuiltIn, GitHub, Dribbble, Behance, plus most ATS career sites (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Taleo).
faq.recruiters.candidateAccountA: No. You can source and pipeline candidates without them ever creating an account. Candidates only sign up if they choose to record a video resume themselves.
faq.recruiters.costA: Solo recruiters start free. Pro is $9.95/month per seat with unlimited sourcing, video screening, and AI matching. Volume discounts available for agencies.
faq.recruiters.gdprA: Yes. We support data subject access, deletion, and export, with retention policies you can configure per pipeline.
faq.recruiters.importA: Yes. Bulk-import candidates from a CSV, your existing ATS, or via our API. Existing tags and notes are preserved.
faq.recruiters.importQ: Can I import my existing candidate database?
faq.recruiters.linkedinA: Yes — and far beyond profile capture. On LinkedIn, Indeed, GitHub, and AngelList the recruiter extension captures candidates one-at-a-time or in bulk from search-result pages (up to 25 per click), auto-enriches each profile with personal email + phone + LinkedIn / GitHub / X / website URLs, drops them onto a job pipeline / list / call queue / outreach sequence with one click, and supports click-to-call (recorded VoIP), click-to-SMS, and click-to-email with every action auto-logged to the candidate's activity timeline. Loxo-Boost parity at $9.95/seat/mo.
faq.recruiters.linkedinQ: Does the Chrome extension work on LinkedIn?
faq.recruiters.matchingA: Match scores combine skills, experience, location, and resume text against the job description. Recruiters routinely see 80–95% relevance on the top results, but you can always tune the weighting.
faq.signIn.freeA: Yes. hired.video is free to start with AI resume scoring, one published video resume, job matching, and 50K AI tokens per month. The Pro plan ($9.95/mo) unlocks unlimited features.
faq.signIn.methodsA: hired.video supports sign-in via Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, Microsoft, email/password, and passwordless magic links. All methods are free.
faq.signIn.methodsQ: What sign-in methods does hired.video support?
faq.signIn.resetA: Click 'Forgot your password?' on the login page, enter your email, and you'll receive a reset link. You can also use passwordless magic link sign-in as an alternative.
faq.signIn.resetQ: How do I reset my password?
faq.signUp.freeA: Yes. hired.video is completely free to start. You get AI resume scoring, one published video resume, job matching (5/month), 50K AI tokens/month, and access to all 10+ career tools. No credit card required.
faq.signUp.freeQ: Is hired.video free to sign up?
faq.signUp.methodsA: hired.video supports sign-up via Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, Microsoft, or email/password. All methods are free and give you immediate access to the platform.
faq.signUp.planA: The free plan includes: 1 published AI video resume, ATS-friendly resume builder, Chrome extension for job tracking, AI tools (resume scorer, optimizer, salary calculator, and more), career dashboard, job matching, and unlimited networking. Pro ($9.95/mo) adds unlimited videos, voice cloning, 1080p export, and 1M AI tokens/month.
faq.signUp.planQ: What's included in the free plan?
faq.signUp.setupA: Under 2 minutes. Sign up with Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, or email, choose your role (Job Seeker, Recruiter, or Employer), and you're in. You can create your first AI video resume in 60 seconds.

messages.studio.q1.a: No. Our AI generates a polished animated video from your written resume — no camera, microphone, or editing skills required. If you'd rather record yourself, you can upload a selfie-style video and the Studio will cut it into your scenes.

messages.studio.q3.a: The AI writes a 4-scene script — hook, experience, achievements, and call-to-action — tailored to your role and target job. It also chooses typography, motion intensity, and scene timing. You can tweak any scene with plain-English instructions.
messages.studio.q3.q: What does the AI actually generate?
messages.studio.q4.a: Yes. Save your colors, logo, and font once in a Brand Kit and every new video automatically applies your brand identity. Great for recruiters, creators, and companies producing multiple videos.

messages.studio.q5.a: One click publishes directly to YouTube, or you can export MP4 and share manually. We also generate a public link with an embed snippet you can drop into LinkedIn, personal websites, or email signatures. Our AI LinkedIn post generator writes the hook, caption, and hashtags for you.
messages.studio.q5.q: Where can I publish my video?
messages.studio.q6.a: Your first AI-generated video is free on every account. Paid plans unlock unlimited generations, premium themes, 1080p export without watermark, voice cloning, brand kits, and video analytics. See the pricing page for current tiers.
messages.studio.q7.a: Export as MP4 in 720p or 1080p. Minimal, moderate, and cinematic motion presets. 16:9 landscape and 9:16 vertical (for TikTok, Reels, and LinkedIn short-form) are both supported.
messages.studio.q7.q: What video formats and resolutions do you support?
messages.studio.q8.a: Yes — the Studio is designed for candidates, recruiters, and companies. Use it to create video resumes, video job ads, company promos, or recruiter personal-brand videos. Every use case uses the same AI engine with different templates.

faq.affiliate.subheading: How commissions, payouts, and attribution work on the hired.video affiliate program.
faq.affiliate.q1.a: You earn 25% commission on the first month of every paid subscription your referrals purchase. One-time payment per referral — for example, if your referral buys a $20/month plan, you earn $5 once when they convert.
faq.affiliate.q2.a: Payouts become eligible as soon as the referred user's first-month subscription charge clears. You can request a payout any time after your balance reaches the $25 minimum threshold.
faq.affiliate.q3.q: What payment methods do you support?
faq.affiliate.q3.a: We support standard payout methods including PayPal and bank transfer. You'll configure your preferred method inside your affiliate settings once your account is approved.
faq.affiliate.q4.a: Every affiliate gets a unique referral link with a ?ref= parameter. When someone clicks your link and signs up, the attribution is stored in their account and credited to you at conversion time. Attribution lasts through the browser session, so you don't lose credit if they sign up a few minutes later.
faq.affiliate.q5.q: Can I promote hired.video on social media?
faq.affiliate.q5.a: Absolutely. Affiliates share hired.video on YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, newsletters, and blogs. We just ask that you disclose the affiliate relationship per FTC / local guidelines and don't run paid ads that compete with our own brand keywords.
faq.affiliate.q6.q: Do I need an audience to apply?
faq.affiliate.q6.a: No minimum audience size — we approve most applications within 48 hours. Career coaches, content creators, recruiters, HR consultants, and anyone who talks to job seekers are all great fits.
faq.affiliate.q7.q: Can I refer recruiters and employers, not just job seekers?
faq.affiliate.q7.a: Yes. You earn commission on any paid plan — job seeker, recruiter, or employer. Recruiter and employer plans are typically higher-priced, so those referrals can be especially valuable.
faq.affiliate.q8.a: No. There's no cap on how much you can earn or how many people you can refer. Top affiliates earn four figures monthly by consistently recommending hired.video to their audience.

faq.pricing.cost.a: hired.video is free to start with generous limits — AI resume scoring, one published Studio project (video, comic, game, or podcast), and 50K AI tokens per month. The Pro plan is ${{monthly}}/month (or ${{yearly}}/year with a 20% annual discount) and includes 1M AI tokens/month, 4K video export, CBZ comic export, watermark-free output, voice cloning, brand kits, and unlimited published projects across every format. faq.pricing.freePlan.q: What's included in the free plan?
faq.pricing.freePlan.a: The free plan includes AI resume scoring, one published Studio project (video, comic, game, or podcast), job-resume matching (5/month), 10 job applications/month, 50K AI tokens for tools like the resume optimizer and salary calculator, and access to the full tool suite. faq.pricing.tryPro.q: Can I try Pro features before committing?

Pro unlocks higher limits, 4K video export, CBZ comic export, watermark-free output, voice cloning, and brand kits.
faq.pricing.tokens.q: What are AI tokens and how do they work?
faq.pricing.tokens.a: AI tokens are the currency that powers every AI feature — resume scoring, Studio script generation (video / comic / game / podcast), job matching, and more. Free users get 50K tokens/month; Pro users get 1M tokens/month. If you need more, top-up token packs start at $3.99 for 500K tokens.
faq.pricing.teamPricing.q: Do you offer team or recruiter pricing?
faq.pricing.teamPricing.a: Yes — Pro supports multi-seat teams with per-seat pricing. Recruiters get access to AI candidate sourcing, match scoring, and a visual hiring pipeline. Contact us for volume discounts on 10+ seats.
faq.pricing.peopleOps.q: What is People Operations, and can I embed it?
faq.pricing.peopleOps.a: People Operations is the CHRO suite for employers — roster & org chart, 1:1s with shared agendas and action items, performance, goals, and team health, on top of the video-first hiring you already use. It's a paid employer feature, multi-tenant and segment-isolated per company. You can also embed your hired.video surfaces (roster, 1:1s, hiring) directly into your own app with a copyable JavaScript snippet — turn it on under your company's Embed settings and inject the embed key from an environment variable (never hardcode it).
faq.pricing.cancel.q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq.pricing.cancel.a: Absolutely. There are no contracts or cancellation fees. Cancel from your account settings at any time and you'll keep access through the end of your billing period. Your data stays safe and you can re-subscribe whenever you want.
faq.pricing.annualDiscount.q: Is there a discount for annual billing?
faq.pricing.annualDiscount.a: Yes — the annual plan saves 20%. Instead of ${{monthly}}/month, you pay ${{yearly}}/year (about ${{monthlyEquivalent}}/month).

messages.rewards.heroDescription: Every meaningful step on hired.video earns you points — applications, tailored resumes, daily streaks, posts to the feed. Trade them for AI credits, a free month of Pro, or a real-world gift card.
messages.rewards.badgesDesc: Earn a badge for each milestone — some unlock once, others (like streak rungs) you can win every time you rebuild them. Each badge pays a one-time points bonus when you unlock it.
messages.rewards.earnDesc: Every action below earns its base point value. Daily caps keep things fair — once you hit the cap for a specific action, that action still counts toward your streak even though the points are paused for the day.
messages.rewards.antiGamingBody: Self-created tasks don't earn points until you've closed 100 of them. System tasks (onboarding, AI-generated suggestions) always pay. This stops anyone from farming the system by spinning up fake to-dos and closing them.
messages.rewards.streaksDesc: Show up daily and your streak grows. Hit a milestone — 7, 14, 30, 60, 90 days — and you earn a repeatable streak badge plus a points bonus. Skip a day and the streak resets to one, but every milestone is winnable again the next time you rebuild.
messages.rewards.cashOutDesc: Four ways to spend what you earn. AI credits, Pro time, and Campaign $ fulfill instantly; gift cards dispatch through Tremendous within minutes (or after a short review if you cross IRS reporting thresholds).
messages.rewards.taxBody: The IRS treats earned rewards as income for non-employees. Once your gift-card redemptions cross $599 in a calendar year, we'll ask you to file a W-9 before dispatching the next one. AI credits and premium-month grants count toward the same threshold.
messages.rewards.faq1A: No. Points stay in your balance until you redeem them. Lifetime earned and lifetime redeemed are tracked separately so you can see your full history.
messages.rewards.faq2Q: Can I lose points I've already earned?
messages.rewards.faq2A: Only in three cases. (1) When you redeem, the points are debited. (2) If you refund a purchase that earned points, the original earning is reversed. (3) If our fraud system flags unusual activity, earning is paused until support reviews — confirmed fraud leads to point reversal.
messages.rewards.faq3Q: How fast do gift cards arrive?
messages.rewards.faq3A: Tremendous typically delivers the gift-card email within minutes of approval. If you cross the $599 / year reporting threshold, we'll collect a W-9 first.
messages.rewards.faq4A: Almost any meaningful action — submitting an application, tailoring a resume, generating a cover letter, completing a task, posting to the feed, running a saved search, making a purchase, or just showing up daily. One qualifying action per day keeps the streak alive.
messages.rewards.faq5A: Self-created tasks don't earn points until you've closed 100 of them. This prevents abuse — without the gate, someone could create and close thousands of fake tasks to farm points. System-generated tasks (onboarding flows, AI suggestions) always pay.
messages.rewards.faq6Q: Can I share points with another user?
messages.rewards.faq6A: Not directly. The affiliate program (separate from this) lets you earn commission on referrals; see /affiliate-program for details.
messages.rewards.faq7A: A few possibilities: you may have hit the daily cap for that action, your role may not be on the rule's eligibility list, or your points may be paused for review. Check the Activity feed on your points page for the per-action audit trail.

headings.forAgencies.heroTitle: Bullhorn-class back-office at one tenth the price.
messages.forAgencies.heroSubtitle: Place candidates, capture time, approve timesheets, derive invoices, track desk margin, manage compliance docs — all inside the same platform your recruiters already use to source.
messages.forAgencies.pricingLine: $9.95 per active employee per month, all-in. Same universal seat price as the rest of the platform. Cancel any seat any time — billing reconciles next cycle.
headings.forAgencies.whatYouGet: What you get out of the box

messages.forAgencies.featurePunchBody: Workforce members punch time on /tasks. One open entry per user — invariant enforced server-side. Real-time elapsed timer + week table + history view, ready out of the box.
messages.forAgencies.featureTimesheetBod: Employees submit weeks, employers approve / reject with required reason, rejected weeks unlock for re-submit. Full audit trail via timesheet_touchpoints — never wonder who approved what.
messages.forAgencies.featureInvoiceBody: Approve a timesheet → invoice line item against the placement's bill rate + contractor payout-ledger accrual against the pay rate. Idempotent on re-approve. Helcim push live; QBO / Xero / Gusto ready to connect.
messages.forAgencies.featureMarginBody: Per-placement YTD revenue, contractor pay, gross margin, approved-timesheet count. Sorted by margin descending. Direct drill-through to the placement detail screen.
messages.forAgencies.featureComplianceBo: I-9, W-9, W-8BEN, COI, BG check, MSA, contract artefacts. Upload to R2, mark signed (native flow) or route through DocuSign. Expiry tracking + nightly cleanup.
messages.forAgencies.featureIntegrations: Connect QuickBooks Online, Xero, Gusto, DocuSign, Helcim. Workforce derivation pushes invoices outbound automatically. Connect / disconnect from /settings → Workforce.
messages.forAgencies.weekPunchInBody: Employee opens /tasks → Timesheet, hits Punch in, adds optional notes, flags billable. The active row appears with a live elapsed timer.
messages.forAgencies.weekSubmitBody: Punch in / out entries accumulate over the week. On Friday the employee clicks Submit week — totals freeze, the entries lock, and the employer's approval queue lights up.
messages.forAgencies.weekApproveBody: Recruiter or employer reviews the queue in /settings → Workforce. One click approves → invoice line item generates against the placement's bill rate, payout ledger accrual against the pay rate, billing_events audit row fires, Helcim invoice goes out.
messages.forAgencies.weekMarginBody: The Desk margin card already shows revenue, contractor pay, and gross margin updated. Drill into any placement for the per-engagement breakdown.
headings.forAgencies.moneyRailsTitle: Money rails stay where they belong
messages.forAgencies.moneyRailsBody: We don't run payroll or own ACH. Approved timesheets push outbound to your QuickBooks / Xero / Gusto / Helcim setup — the systems your accountant already trusts. We're the recruiting layer; your GL stays sovereign.
messages.forAgencies.complianceBody: I-9 expiry, COI renewal, contract attestation — every doc has a kind, status, and expiry. Nightly cron flips overdue docs to expired so audits never surprise you. DocuSign integration ready when you flip it on.
messages.forAgencies.faqSubheading: Everything an agency operator wants to know before switching.
headings.forAgencies.faqDiffQuestion: How is this different from Bullhorn or Vincere?
messages.forAgencies.faqDiffAnswer: Bullhorn-class platforms charge $99–$200/seat/mo for the same workflow we ship at $9.95 per active employee. We focus on the recruiting-vertical workflow (placements, timesheets, candidate-bound docs, desk margin) and push the generic accounting + payroll work to your existing QuickBooks / Xero / Gusto via outbound connectors. You keep the systems your accountant already runs; we add the placement-and-timesheet layer on top.
headings.forAgencies.faqHelcimQuestion: Do I have to use Helcim for billing?
messages.forAgencies.faqHelcimAnswer: Helcim is the default because it's wired live for invoice push + recurring seat amounts. If you already run QuickBooks Online, Xero, or Gusto, you can connect those instead from Settings → Workforce → Integrations. Each new approved timesheet generates an invoice locally; the configured provider gets the push outbound. The local invoice + payout ledger stays the canonical source so connector retries are safe.
headings.forAgencies.faqSeatQuestion: How does seat billing actually work?
messages.forAgencies.faqSeatAnswer: Every active employee in your workspace counts as one $9.95/mo seat. When you invite an employee and they accept, the seat count goes up + your subscription amount updates. When you deactivate an employee from the roster, the seat count drops and the next cycle bills less. No multi-tier confusion, no per-feature add-ons.
headings.forAgencies.faqEmployeesQuestio: Can my employees use the rest of the platform?
messages.forAgencies.faqEmployeesAnswer: Yes. Employees get a full dashboard with social features, content posting, and engagement on hired.video — adoption is part of the value, not boxed-in time tracking. They just don't show up in candidate-discovery surfaces (since they're not on the job market while employed by you).
messages.forAgencies.faqTimesheetsAnswer: Every active contract placement carries a bill rate (what you charge the client) and a pay rate (what you pay the contractor). When an employer approves a weekly timesheet, the workforce service automatically: (1) creates an invoice line item using billable hours × bill rate, (2) records a payout-ledger accrual using total hours × pay rate, (3) emits a billing_events audit row, (4) pushes the invoice through your configured accounting connector. Idempotent on re-approve — no double-billing.
headings.forAgencies.faqDocsQuestion: Where do compliance documents (I-9, W-9, etc.) live?
messages.forAgencies.faqDocsAnswer: Documents attach to a placement or to a company-bound employee. Upload the file to our R2 storage, mark signed manually (native flow) or route through DocuSign for a full audit trail. Each doc has a kind enum (i9 / w9 / w8ben / coi / bg_check / msa / sow / offer_letter / nda / other), optional expiry, and pending → signed → expired → revoked status. Expired docs flag automatically on the nightly cron.
headings.forAgencies.faqPrintQuestion: Can I print or export timesheets and invoices?
messages.forAgencies.faqPrintAnswer: Yes. Every timesheet and invoice has a print URL that returns an A4-styled print-ready HTML page — your browser converts it to PDF via Print → Save as PDF. Click the printer icon next to any timesheet row in the approval queue, the My Timesheets list, or a placement's Timesheets tab.
messages.forAgencies.faqCommissionAnswer: Already supported. The placements aggregate carries a placementSplits child table for commission % across recruiters, sourcers, and managers. Set the split when you create the placement; the commission engine fans out per row so a 50/50 placement shows the correct half on each recruiter's commission ledger.
headings.forAgencies.faqSeparateAccountQ: Do I need a separate account for my employees?
messages.forAgencies.faqSeparateAccountA: No — invite-only flow. From Settings → Account & Billing, invite an employee by email with role=employee. They get an email link; if they're new they sign up with that same email first, then accept — which links them to your workspace via user_company_role_associations. They sign in with their own credentials; nothing shared.
headings.forAgencies.faqPerformanceQuest: How do I see how my recruiters are performing?
messages.forAgencies.faqPerformanceAnswe: The Workforce → Desk margin section shows per-placement YTD revenue, contractor pay, and gross margin, grouped by recruiter on the placement. Click any row to drill into the placement detail screen — Overview / Documents / Timesheets / Margin tabs. Sources from approved-timesheet derivations only, so the numbers always match what was actually invoiced.

headings.security.heroTitleLead: Built to industry standards. Audited against
messages.security.heroSubtitle: NIST 800-63B identity assurance. OWASP ASVS Level 2. RFC-grade token handling. Phishing-resistant passkeys. Per-device sessions with hard revocation. No mocked claims — every "Implemented" badge below points to code shipping today.
messages.security.disclosureBody: with reproduction steps. We acknowledge within 2 business days, triage within 5, and aim to ship a fix within 30 days for high-severity issues. Acting in good faith is welcome — we don't pursue legal action against researchers who follow responsible disclosure.
messages.security.sectionIdentity: Who you are, how we verify it, and how we make MFA invisible when it can be.
messages.security.sectionSessions: Per-device sessions with hard revocation, refresh rotation, and forced re-auth on sensitive changes.
messages.security.sectionAbuse: Layered gates that turn bots away without burdening real users.
messages.security.sectionGeo: Where account creation is allowed, and where it isn't.
messages.security.sectionStorage: What we hash, what we encrypt, and what we never store at all.
messages.security.identityPasskeys: Phishing-resistant hardware-bound credentials. ES256 (P-256) supported. Available on every account.
messages.security.identityEmailOtp: Numeric one-time codes delivered to the verified email on file. Attempts are rate-limited; codes single-use.
messages.security.identityMagicLink: Passwordless login by clicking a one-time link emailed to the address on file.
messages.security.identityTotp: Google Authenticator / 1Password / Authy compatible. Schema and storage shipped; UX wiring in progress.
messages.security.identityAdaptiveMfa: Trusted devices skip MFA on subsequent logins; new country / impossible-travel / VPN-on-new-device escalates challenge.
headings.security.identityBackupCodes: MFA backup codes (10 single-use, hashed at rest)
messages.security.identityBackupCodes: Rescue codes generated on MFA enable, regenerable from Security Settings.
messages.security.sessionDeviceCap: Per-user enforcement; oldest session evicted on 4th login. Self-service device list at /security/sessions with per-device revoke.
messages.security.sessionRefreshRotation: Tokens rotate on every refresh. Replay of a rotated token revokes the entire session family — the canonical token-theft signal.
messages.security.sessionIdleTimeout: Sessions expire on inactivity OR absolute age, whichever comes first. last_seen_at is debounced to keep the auth path fast.
headings.security.sessionMassInvalidatio: Mass session invalidation on password reset / email change
messages.security.sessionMassInvalidatio: Every active session row is revoked AND session_version is bumped on these events, so legacy JWTs are rejected too.
messages.security.sessionEmailChange: Old address must confirm AND new address must verify before users.email mutates. Stops session-hijack account takeover.
messages.security.abuseTurnstile: Bot defense on signup, password reset, and 2FA flows when configured.
messages.security.abuseRateLimits: Layered limits stop credential-stuffing waves whether they rotate IPs, emails, or both. Workers Rate Limit binding.
messages.security.abuseDisposableEmail: Curated list of throwaway-email providers rejected at signup.
messages.security.abuseCompromisedPasswo: Passwords are checked against the haveibeenpwned breach corpus on register and change. Plaintext never leaves the worker.
messages.security.abuseAccountLockout: Brute-force attempts auto-lock the account. Audit-trailed lock state with manual SuperAdmin unlock available.

messages.chromeExtension.recBulk: On LinkedIn / Indeed / GitHub list pages a one-click "Capture all" sources up to 25 candidates per request — each runs through the same enrichment pipeline as the single capture.

messages.chromeExtension.faqSubheading: Everything people ask before installing the hired.video Chrome extensions.
messages.chromeExtension.faqFreeA: Yes. Both the Job Seeker and Recruiter extensions are free to install from the Chrome Web Store. The Job Seeker extension includes one-click job tracking, resume match scoring, and AI resume tailoring; the Recruiter extension includes profile + contact-enrichment capture, bulk sourcing, lists / call queues / outreach sequences, and the kanban pipeline.
headings.chromeExtension.faqLoxoQ: How does the recruiter extension compare to Loxo Boost?
messages.chromeExtension.faqLoxoA: Feature parity at 1/17th the price. The hired.video recruiter extension captures candidate profiles from any site (LinkedIn, GitHub, Indeed, portfolio sites), auto-enriches with personal email + phone + LinkedIn / GitHub / X / website URLs, drops candidates straight onto a job pipeline, list, or call queue, enrolls them in multi-step outreach sequences, and supports click-to-call (recorded VoIP via SignalWire) — all auto-logged to the activity timeline. Loxo Basic is $169/user/mo; the hired.video Pro plan is $9.95/seat/mo.
headings.chromeExtension.faqCallQ: How does the click-to-call work — do I need my own VoIP provider?
messages.chromeExtension.faqCallA: No. The extension's "Call via hired.video" toggle routes phone clicks through SignalWire on a hired.video business number you provision in seconds from the settings panel. Calls are recorded, attached to the candidate's activity timeline with the SignalWire SID, and counted against your monthly minute budget (Pro includes 100 minutes). Turn the toggle off and tel: clicks fall back to the OS dialer with no recording.
messages.chromeExtension.faqSitesA: The extensions auto-detect jobs, profiles, and companies on LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, Dice, SimplyHired, Lever, Greenhouse, Workday, Wellfound, Built In, GitHub, and generic fallbacks for everything else. The interactive 🪄 picker (job / profile / company modes) handles sites the auto-detector doesn't recognise and replays your captured selectors on every subsequent visit.
headings.chromeExtension.faqAccountQ: Do I need a hired.video account to use the extension?
messages.chromeExtension.faqAccountA: Yes — the extension syncs your tracked jobs, scored resumes, talent pool, lists, call queues, sequences, and call recordings to your hired.video account. Create a free account at hired.video/signup if you don't already have one. Everything persists across devices and team members.
headings.chromeExtension.faqScoreQ: How does the AI match score work?
messages.chromeExtension.faqScoreA: When you click Score on a job posting, the extension sends the job description to hired.video's AI, which compares it against your master resume (job seeker side) or your talent pool (recruiter side) — skills, experience level, keywords, and required qualifications. You get a score and a list of specific gaps to improve.
messages.chromeExtension.faqPrivacyA: The extension only activates on job-board / profile / company pages, and it only sends data to hired.video when you explicitly click Track, Score, Extract, Capture all, or invoke the picker. Telemetry has a one-click opt-out in Settings; "picker_capture" events strip the literal selector + value content before they ever leave the browser. We don't track general browsing, share data with third parties, or inject ads.
headings.chromeExtension.faqBrowserQ: Does the extension work on Edge, Firefox, or Safari?
messages.chromeExtension.faqBrowserA: The extensions are built for Chrome and Chromium-based browsers (Brave, Edge, Arc, Opera). A Firefox version is on the roadmap. Safari is not currently supported.

messages.studioLayout.faqSubheading: The quick answers to what creators ask before they generate their first studio project.
messages.studioLayout.faqQ1Question: What can I make in the Studio?
messages.studioLayout.faqQ1Answer: Pick a format and start: {{formats}}. Each format mounts its own canvas runtime inside the same editor — switching kinds is as simple as picking a different template.
messages.studioLayout.faqQ2Question: Do I need to record myself on camera?
messages.studioLayout.faqQ2Answer: No. The AI generates a polished result from your written brief — no camera, microphone, or editing skills required. If you'd rather record yourself, video and podcast projects accept selfie-style recordings that the Studio will cut into your scenes.
messages.studioLayout.faqQ3Question: How long does it take to make a project?
messages.studioLayout.faqQ3Answer: Most creators finish their first project in about 60 seconds of wall-clock time. Paste your brief, pick a template, and the AI handles the script + scaffolding for the format you picked (scenes, panels, levels, episode chapters). Edit anything you like before exporting.
messages.studioLayout.faqQ4Question: What does the AI actually generate?
messages.studioLayout.faqQ4Answer: The AI writes a format-aware scaffold — video / podcast scripts get a hook → middle → CTA arc; comics get a 6-page narrative with panel art direction; games get level layouts with starter sprites + behaviors. The brief grounds the output in your real material (resume, job spec, company info).
messages.studioLayout.faqQ5Question: Can I use my own branding?
messages.studioLayout.faqQ5Answer: Yes. Save your colours, logo, and font once in a Brand Kit and every new project automatically applies your brand identity — across every format, not just video. Great for recruiters, creators, and companies producing multiple pieces.
messages.studioLayout.faqQ6Question: Where can I publish my work?
messages.studioLayout.faqQ6Answer: Each format ships with the right destinations: video → YouTube / LinkedIn / public link + embed; podcast → RSS feed, Apple Podcasts, Spotify for Creators; game → itch.io, GitHub Pages, embed on hired.video; comic → hired.video reader, Webtoon, Tapas; voice → marketplace + profile embed; image → profile gallery + asset library. The publish menu self-gates per format.
messages.studioLayout.faqQ7Answer: Your first AI-generated project is free on every account. Paid plans unlock unlimited generations, premium themes, 1080p / lossless export without watermark, voice cloning, brand kits, and analytics. See the pricing page for current tiers.
messages.studioLayout.faqQ8Question: What formats and resolutions do you support?
messages.studioLayout.faqQ8Answer: Video exports as MP4 in 720p or 1080p (16:9 landscape and 9:16 vertical). Podcasts export as MP3 / M4A / OGG / WAV with chapter markers. Animations export as GIF / WebP. Comics export as PDF / CBZ / PNG strip / motion MP4. Games export as a self-contained HTML5 ZIP that runs on any web host. Voice exports as MP3 / WAV. Images export as PNG / JPG / WebP / SVG.
messages.studioLayout.faqQ9Question: Can recruiters and companies use the Studio too?
messages.studioLayout.faqQ9Answer: Yes — the Studio is designed for candidates, recruiters, and companies across every format. Video resumes, podcast trailers, recruiter personal-brand promos, company sizzle reels, hiring-themed games, employer-brand comics, voiceover demos. Same AI engine, the right template for each use case.

faq.resumes.subheading: Everything people ask before building their first video resume on hired.video.
faq.resumes.q1.a: A video resume is a short 30–90 second video in which you introduce yourself, explain your experience, and make a case for why you're a great fit. On hired.video, AI can generate a polished video resume directly from your existing written resume — you don't need a camera or editing skills.
faq.resumes.q2.q: Do I still need a traditional resume?
faq.resumes.q2.a: Yes. Most applications still require a text resume (for ATS parsing), so hired.video lets you build both: an ATS-friendly written resume and an AI-generated video resume that pairs with it. Many members share the video via a link on their written resume and LinkedIn profile.
faq.resumes.q3.q: How long should my video resume be?
faq.resumes.q3.a: We recommend 30–90 seconds. Long enough to make a real impression, short enough that recruiters actually watch it all the way through. Our AI scripts are tuned to this length by default.
faq.resumes.q4.q: Can I edit my video resume after creating it?
faq.resumes.q4.a: Yes. You can edit the script, swap scenes, change the theme, re-record any section, or regenerate the whole video with a new angle. Every video is saved as a project you can come back to any time.
faq.resumes.q5.a: Every video is private by default. You choose when to publish it, and you can pick public (indexed, shareable link), unlisted (link only), or private (just you). You can revoke a share link any time.
faq.resumes.q6.q: How do recruiters find my video resume?
faq.resumes.q6.a: If you publish your video publicly, it appears in the hired.video resume gallery and can be surfaced by our AI matching engine when recruiters search for candidates. You can also share your personal link directly on LinkedIn, email signatures, and written resumes.
faq.resumes.q7.q: Does hired.video work with ATS systems?
faq.resumes.q7.a: Yes. Written resumes built on hired.video export to clean, ATS-parseable PDFs (or .docx) that work with Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Taleo, iCIMS, and most other ATS platforms. Our resume optimizer also flags wording or structure issues that commonly break ATS parsing.
faq.resumes.q8.q: What does a video resume cost?
faq.resumes.q8.a: Your first video resume is free. Paid plans unlock unlimited video generations, advanced themes, voiceover cloning, video analytics, and removing the hired.video watermark. See the pricing page for current tiers.
